description: This file defines classes implementing raw input devices (keyboard, mouse, touchscreen) for the Playwright project, specifically for the BiDi protocol. It includes methods for simulating key presses, mouse movements, clicks, wheel scrolling, and touchscreen taps, utilizing external BiDi protocol modules.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input methods for the BiDi protocol, including key down, key up, and send text.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements mouse input methods for the BiDi protocol, including move, down, up, and wheel actions.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Stub class for touchscreen input, with a tap method.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the BiDi session for the keyboard implementation.
